newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Centauri Corp commercial paper programme.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Centauri Corp commercial paper programme.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Monday it assigned its AAA/A1 plus ratings to Centauri Corp (Centauri) and CC Inc's U.S. and Euro commercial paper and medium term note programmes, $5.0 billion each totalling $20 billion.
S&P said Centauri's rating was based on the following.
-- The credit quality of the investment portfolio and the derivative counterparties.
-- Its adherence to its operating limits.

"Centari will purchase high credit quality securities with the proceeds of its issues. These securities are purchased with the view to holding them to maturity. The market risk associated with these will be managed through the use of derivatives, thereby picking up the credit spread between Centauri's cost of funds (AAA/AA1 plus) and the underlying security," S&P said.
